documents.title: A small circuit, three connected quantities
documents.text: For an ohmic resistor at fixed temperature, voltage equals current multiplied by resistance: V = I × R. A current of 2 amperes through a resistance of 6 ohms requires 12 volts. This relationship is a model for ohmic components, not every electrical device.
documents.summary: Connect voltage, current, and resistance in one worked example.

images.alt: An original Polymath diagram: a 12 volt source connected to a 6 ohm resistor carries 2 amperes.
images.caption: Polymath original illustration · V = I × R = 2 A × 6 Ω = 12 V

quiz.question: What voltage drives 2 amperes through 6 ohms?

documents.title: Ask who created the evidence
documents.text: A primary source comes from the period being studied. Evaluate who created it, its purpose, its audience and its context. Compare its account with independent evidence; proximity to events does not establish that every claim is accurate.

documents.title: Access should fit the task
documents.text: Least privilege grants a user or service only the permissions needed for its task. A report reader normally needs read access to the relevant reports, not permission to delete accounts. Review access regularly. This is conceptual study material, not an official certification question or syllabus.

documents.title: Reasoning and premises both matter
documents.text: A deductively valid argument cannot have true premises and a false conclusion. A sound argument is valid and has true premises. Assess the inference and the evidence supporting its premises separately.
